summary: PhysicsLabRecipe lacks an explicit canonical geometry scalar-domain contract before Roblox realization.
evidence: PhysicsLabRecipe primitive construction validates MaterialDNA and transparency range but does not require finite positive size axes or finite position/rotation axes; object placement likewise lacks finite position/rotation validation.

Current physics_lab_recipe coverage checks identity, materials, ObjectGenome bindings and selected door geometry, but does not assert finite/positive geometry domains across every primitive and object placement.
Retained PR #423 hardens PhysicsLabScale conversion inputs/derived outputs and validation snapshots; it does not establish the upstream canonical recipe geometry-domain invariant.

Recommended bounded successor after the retained geometry stack is safe to schedule: validate canonical recipe geometry scalars at authoring/build time and add pure regressions covering non-finite placement/rotation, non-positive primitive dimensions, and finite transparency. No Studio evidence is required.
